listening_round_2026_08_22.what: first human ratings of the identity gate's own audio, scores concealed until rated
listening_round_2026_08_22.reading: ECAPA does the job it claims and no other. Ranked by the listener, the four arms fall in almost the gate's own order on IDENTITY (rho +0.80, one inversion between the two failures) - the first outside check this gate has had. On USABILITY the relationship inverts (rho -0.60): both arms the gate FAILED were rated 5, completely clean, and the worst clip in the set is one the gate PASSED. husky_baritone_20s_m_anime scored 0.7524, cleared the 0.45 threshold, and repeats a word, cracks, and degenerates into non-words. A degenerate generation keeps the target speaker's timbre, so speaker similarity cannot see it, and nothing else in the promotion path looks. n=4, so no rate is claimed - but the failure mode is demonstrated, not estimated.
listening_round_2026_08_22.open_question: warm_alto_50s_f_gothic is the largest disagreement: ECAPA 0.0342, 'a different person entirely', against a listener's 3. That adapter is one of three traced the same day to the full-cast Dracula, so a dataset mixing two cast members would make BOTH readings correct. Testable, and untested.

reference_mismatch_hypothesis.asked: does a reference clip that is not the validation speaker explain the 0.0342 on warm_alto_50s_f_gothic?
reference_mismatch_hypothesis.reading: Three of the four order correctly - the wider the ref/val gap the lower the score - and warm_baritone_50s_m breaks it outright: a 4.10 semitone gap with the HIGHEST score in the set, 0.7807, passed. One counterexample in four is not a pattern, and this is recorded so the idea is not proposed a second time as though untested. What survives is narrower and not about the gate at all: THREE OF FOUR datasets have a reference clip 4+ semitones from their own validation audio, and the generated clip tracks the reference (warm_alto: ref 107.8, generated 109.4, val 142.7). Median f0 is a crude proxy for speaker identity; settling this needs ECAPA between ref and val, which needs speechbrain and therefore the sibling interpreter.
